name: vat-price-field
title: VAT price field
description: Enter a price once and see both sides, with and without VAT, with a switch for which one you type and the VAT worked out between them.
docs: value is the amount as typed, in minor units (1240 is 12.40): the price without VAT when mode is 'excluding', the price with VAT when it is 'including'; mode and rate are controlled the same way, or start with defaultValue, defaultMode and defaultRate (the highest of rates). rates are percentages, 0, 9 and 21 unless you pass your own; a rate with decimals (7.7) works. onChange(price, input) gets { net, vat, gross, rate } in minor units, worked out in whole numbers and rounded half up exactly once so net + vat is always gross, or null for an empty field, and input is { value, mode, rate } to hand back when you control the field. Changing the switch keeps the typed number and works out the other side. currency sets the symbol and the decimals (two for euros, none for yen), a comma or a point both work as the decimal sign, and name adds hidden inputs for net, vat, gross and rate. A screen reader hears the result when the field is left or the switch or the rate changes. vat.ts exports fromNet, fromGross and vatPrice, so your server can work out the same numbers. locale writes the amounts and labels holds the fixed words, 'VAT {rate}' among them, for another language or another tax.
